methods.name: protected void startUpdate()
methods.comment:
* Called when the list of enabled ranges has changed. This will be
         * followed by zero or more calls to {@link #addRange} followed by
         * a call to {@link #finishUpdate}.

methods.name: protected void addRange(int startId, int endId, boolean selected)
methods.comment:
* Called after {@link #startUpdate} to indicate a range of enabled
         * values.
         * @param startId the first id included in the range
         * @param endId the last id included in the range

methods.name: protected boolean finishUpdate()
methods.comment:
* Called to indicate the end of a range update started by the
         * previous call to {@link #startUpdate}.
         * @return true if successful, false otherwise

methodNames: protected void addRange(int startId, int endId, boolean selected)
